def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width uniform rows and full-height uniform columns are panel dividers.
    divider_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    div_colors = [grid[r][0] for r in divider_rows] + [grid[0][c] for c in divider_cols]
    # The dominant non-divider color is the panel background.
    vals = [v for r, row in enumerate(grid) if r not in divider_rows
            for c, v in enumerate(row) if c not in divider_cols]
    background = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
    row_bounds = [-1] + divider_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + divider_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds) - 1):
        row_out = []
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri] + 1, row_bounds[ri + 1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds) - 1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci] + 1, col_bounds[ci + 1]
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row_out.append(1 if count >= 2 else background)
        out.append(row_out)
    return out
PY
